text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Mile CS Nambu Hai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*——
...*Phew*...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're challenging her too, Tarumae-chan.
...Challenging Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't forgotten the words from when
we watched the 'Kashiwa Kinen' with Acute-san and the others.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Are you talkin' about the iron clubs the ogres carry?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Keeping those words close to my heart,
I've been honing my own weapons as well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To bring victory back to my hometown.
So that I can do Tomakomai proud—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What an unpleasant jerk.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Are ya craftin' your weapon just 'cause somebody told ya to?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I consulted my own brain a hundred times
before preparing all this, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Half-assed ideas ain't gonna beat me, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She is...
the pinnacle that we're aiming for from here on.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: âAre you watching, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gaze at Espoir City from the paddock.
I felt like our eyes met for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For this Mile Championship Nambu Hai,
putting on the final touches was left in the hands of Espoir City.
choice_data_list: (You built your own running style yourself.)
(You built your own way of running.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, she's no longer the challenger—she's the reigning champion.
The others have surely studied her and devised counterstrategies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
I have no worries about her race.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A-And there it is! Espoir City!
Raises her fist straight toward the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"What could this mean?
The race hasn't even started yet, and—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Can't you tell?
It's the winner's pose!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Even after the race is over,
I'll do the exact same thing to ya!!
